name: Montage Healdsburg
insider_take: Nestled in the heart of Sonoma County wine country, this luxury resort sits on 258 acres where world-class hospitality meets California's most coveted terroir.
whats_special: The resort features its own 16-acre vineyard and winery, where guests can participate in harvest activities and private tastings. The property's signature spa treatment uses locally-sourced grape seed oil and mud from the Russian River Valley. Healdsburg's town square, just minutes away, hosts over 200 wineries within a 15-mile radius, making it one of the most concentrated premium wine regions in North America.
pro_tip: Book the "Harvest Experience" package during crush season (September-October) to stomp grapes barefoot in the resort's own vineyard and blend your custom wine to take home.
dont_miss: The rooftop infinity pool offers panoramic views of the Mayacamas Mountains, and the resort's farm-to-table restaurant sources ingredients from their on-site organic garden. Take the complimentary Tesla to explore the legendary Russian River Valley AVA, where Pinot Noir and Chardonnay vines benefit from the unique fog patterns that roll in from the Pacific Ocean just 12 miles west.
pros: Prime Sonoma County wine country location with vineyard views
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities with local-inspired treatments
Farm-to-table dining featuring local Sonoma ingredients
Elegant accommodations with private terraces and fireplaces
cons: Remote wine country location requires transportation planning
